facts.fact: Marco 按 Aelindor 的命令开始对 Max 进行私人近战训练
Marco 教 Max 步法：转身、横向移动、斜向后退以避开变异体的冲锋路线
facts.quote: Footwork first. Pivots, lateral shifts, the angled retreats that kept you out of a mutant’s charge lane.

facts.fact: Marco 反复纠正 Max 的防御姿势，共纠正了三十六次
facts.quote: He corrected my guard three dozen times.

facts.fact: Max 一直练到天色变成琥珀色，双臂脱力垂在身侧
facts.quote: I trained until the light turned amber and my arms hung dead at my sides.

facts.fact: 黄昏时分 Frost 开一辆吉普车停在训练场旁，坐在驾驶座上等 Max
facts.quote: Near dusk, a jeep halted by the training ring. Frost sat behind the wheel, impeccable as always.

facts.fact: 晚餐开始时 Caspian 拉开空椅请 Max 入座，并当面称赞她
facts.quote: “You look stunning, Max.” Caspian pulled out the empty chair and stood beside it, one hand on the back

facts.fact: Drakken 推开椅子起身，以“有职责要处理”为由中途离席
facts.quote: “Excuse me.” He shoved his chair back, the scrape making everyone flinch, and stood. “I have a duty to see to.”

facts.fact: 晚餐继续，Max 吃了汉堡、对 Aelindor 微笑，并被 Caspian 的笑话逗笑
facts.quote: I ate my burger, smiled at Aelindor, and laughed at Caspian’s jokes.

relations: Marco 受 Aelindor 之命担任 Max 的私人近战教练
Frost（少校）负责在训练结束后用车把 Max 送回 Greyhold 军官宿舍
Max 在 Greyhold 使用 Aelindor 的房间洗澡更衣
Aelindor 或 Caspian 为 Max 弄来了女装与女性内衣
Max 当晚与 Aelindor、Drakken、Caspian 三位王子共进晚餐
Caspian 当众向 Max 示好并为她拉椅子
Drakken 因无法与 Max 同处一室而中途离席，Aelindor 让 Caspian 放他走
